title: What Happens on a Free Walking Tour: Quick Summary
items: **A free walking tour has no fixed price:** you join without paying up front and tip at the end. My own walk, Berlin Then and Now, costs €25 per person, paid when you book.
**My walk is about 2.5 hours on foot** through the historic core of the former East Berlin, at a comfortable pace on mostly flat ground.
**Eleven stops and sixteen places, Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt:** from the World Clock and the TV Tower to Museum Island and the old courtyards.
**One clear price:** €25 per person, paid when you book, and no more than 10 people in the group.
**A good fit** if you are new to Berlin, want the centre explained rather than just photographed, and can walk for about 2.5 hours.
**A poor fit** if you cannot walk for about 2.5 hours or want to go inside the museums; we walk the edges of Museum Island, not the galleries.
**My move: scrub through the whole route above before you book,** so nothing about the walk is a surprise.
